visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a top-down view of a light-colored wooden surface with prominent grain patterns. A pair of hands enters the frame from the top, placing a brown leather-textured watch case with a small gold-embossed brand logo in the center. (2) The hands interact with the case, unbuttoning a small strap and slowly unfolding the dual-wing top to reveal a silver stainless steel watch nestled inside. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the texture of the leather and the metallic sheen of the watch. (3) The camera zooms in to a medium close-up of the watch face, which features a textured champagne-colored dial and black outer ring. A hand reaches in and begins to slowly peel back a transparent protective plastic film from the sapphire glass surface, creating subtle reflections. (4) Multiple macro close-up shots follow, showcasing the intricate details of the watch, including the embossed text on the dial, the movement of the white-tipped second hand, and the brushed finish of the stainless steel indices. (5) The final sequence features extreme close-ups of the watch's hands and the 'MADE IN JAPAN' text at the bottom of the dial, while the camera slowly pans across the surface to emphasize the depth and craftsmanship of the timepiece.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat and bouncy vintage jazz music begins immediately with a walking bassline and syncopated piano chords. The tempo is brisk and energetic. (2) A sharp, metallic 'click' sound occurs as the button of a case is released, followed by a soft, textured sliding sound as the wings of the case are pulled apart. (3) The BGM continues with the addition of bright brass stabs. A high-pitched, crinkling 'plastic peel' sound begins as protective film is removed, lasting for several seconds with varying frequency. (4) The jazz music transitions into a solo piano section with light percussion, maintaining the upbeat rhythm. The acoustic environment is very clean with no audible room reverb. (5) The audio concludes with a final brass flourish as the music reaches a resolving major chord, timed with the final close-up shot of the watch dial.

It aims to emphasize the watch's vintage aesthetic, technical specifications (200m water resistance, anti-magnetic properties), and its 'Made in Japan' craftsmanship through meticulous visual detail and an upbeat, classy audio track.
